answer: A sybil farm is a business, so price its business model out of existence. Only a random sample of each identity's work is re-executed, but the sampling rate rises for clustered wander accounts, and a single failed check escalates the whole cluster to full horizon review. Findings land in the spiral record and slash the cluster's shared deposit. Because escalation is public and cheap to trigger, a farm cannot average bad work across many seats the way it can under independent random checks.
